description: Shared PII sanitization rules for Spendly. Loaded by the Kotlin sanitizer (backend) and the Python sanitizer (pdf-parser). Both MUST produce identical output for contracts/fixtures/sanitizer-cases.json. The algorithm is specified in contracts/README.md (section 'Sanitizer algorithm'); this file holds the data.
regexDialect: Common subset of java.util.regex and Python re: no named groups, no \d/\w/\b/\s (use explicit ASCII classes), scoped inline flags only as (?i:...). Patterns are compiled with no global flags.

hmac.key: UTF-8 bytes of the content of the file at SPENDLY_HMAC_SECRET_PATH, with leading/trailing whitespace trimmed

rules.description: IBAN, compact or printed in space-separated chunks; replaced by country + last 4 and pseudonymized with an HMAC token.
Romanian personal numeric code (CNP), 13 digits with a valid birth month/day and checksum. Runs before 'pan' so a CNP is removed, never masked.

Payment card number: 13-19 digits, optionally grouped with single spaces, Luhn-valid, not glued to letters or a leading '+' (so IBAN fragments and +phone numbers are not mistaken for cards). Masked to the last 4 digits.
Romanian phone number (mobile 07xx, landline 02x/03x) with +40/0040/0 prefix and optional single-space grouping, or an international +<digits> number.

Private person name after a transfer keyword (e.g. 'TRANSFER CATRE ION POPESCU', 'To Ion Popescu'). Group 1 = keyword (kept), group 2 = 2-3 capitalized words. Pseudonymized as [PERSON#<token8>]. Company names and single words are left alone.
